description:
Create a usage meter between a provider and a consumer agent.

    unit: what is being counted (call, token, kwh, ...). Price is in minor
    currency units (cents) per unit. Returns the meter_id.

consumer.description: Agent id of the party consuming it.
consumer.title: Consumer

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD.
currency.title: Currency

price_minor_per_unit.description: Price per unit in minor units (cents).
price_minor_per_unit.title: Price Minor Per Unit

provider.description: Agent id of the party providing the service.
provider.title: Provider

sla_target.description: Target success rate between 0 and 1. Default 0.99.
sla_target.title: Sla Target

unit.description: What is counted, for example call, token or kwh.
unit.title: Unit

name: create_meter
title: Create meter
